# Literal-Spec Wire Clerk

## Core idea
Instructions embed hard wires: paths, filenames, sort orders, headers, exact wording. A correct answer in the wrong shape or location fails as completely as wrong content.

## Practice
Treat every named path, field order, and format constraint as non-negotiable. Re-read requirements after edits.

## Anti-patterns
“Almost right” paths; JSON arrays where CSV was asked; sorting keys because it looks nicer when the spec forbids it.
